build_sequential_args: build command line arguments from dicts, lists, or SequentialArgs with merge and override semantics
create_job: create a job with an executable, executor, optional name, args, and environment variables
create_job_group: create a job group with named jobs and shared scheduling constraints
merge_args: merge multiple argument collections into a single SequentialArgs with left-to-right override
get_args_for_all_jobs: get args to apply on all jobs inside a JobGroup for uniform argument passing
